versions.changelog:
No changes detected in this release.

- Version updated without any file or documentation changes.
- No modifications to functionality or interface.

Initial release of ChatGPT Apps Builder.

- Enables creating, designing, implementing, testing, and deploying ChatGPT Apps with a full workflow.
- Supports adding MCP tools, widgets, authentication, and database integration.
- Provides commands for scaffolding, tool/widget management, app validation, testing, and deployment.
- Includes guided UX analysis, anti-pattern checks, and use case/story design templates.
- Facilitates automated app structure, code generation, deployment scripts, and widget previews.
- Integrates with Auth0 and Supabase for authentication options.
